requirements.verifier_assertion: check_revision_identity: revision_id() is ordering-independent, changes with image, and drives ==/!=
must_include: independent of dict key order
changes when a substantive config change
Equality between Revisions is decided by revision_id()

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_policy_validation: missing image, unknown strategy, and batch_size<1 raise RevisionError
must_include: missing image must raise RevisionError
an unknown strategy must raise RevisionError
batch_size must be >= 1, otherwise raise RevisionError

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_initial_rollout: a first rollout brings up exactly `replicas` containers on the target image
must_include: A first rollout brings up exactly the requested replica count on the target image
create_host_config -> create_container -> start

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_plan_is_pure_and_idempotent: plan() has no side effects and a settled service re-plans to a no-op
must_include: it must not create or delete any container
the plan is a do-nothing plan
plan.is_noop is a boolean attribute

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_rolling_batches: 4 replicas at batch_size 2 -> 2 batches; rollout preserves count and ends on new image
must_include: 4 replicas at batch_size 2 rolling yields 2
the final replica count is preserved

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_health_triggers_rollback: unhealthy new revision -> RolloutFailed(rolled_back=True) and service left on only the old revision at original count
must_include: unhealthy after health_attempts probes
the service runs ONLY the old revision with the original replica count
the raised RolloutFailed has rolled_back True

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_no_auto_rollback: with auto_rollback off a failed rollout is not reverted and rolled_back is False
must_include: If auto_rollback is off, the failure is raised as-is with no restoration and rolled_back is False

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_blue_green_ordering: promote step present, all creates before promote, removes after promote
must_include: all create steps come before the promote
the old replicas are removed only after the promote
A blue/green plan must contain exactly one promote step

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_recreate: every remove comes before any create and it ends on the new image
must_include: every remove comes before any create

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_canary_success: canary plan contains analyze; a passing canary migrates the whole fleet
must_include: A canary plan must contain an analyze step
migrate the remaining replicas like a rolling update

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_canary_rejection_rolls_back: a failing canary raises RolloutFailed and leaves the old revision
must_include: with auto_rollback on, rolls back to the old version
leaving the service on the old revision

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_canary_metric_thresholds: comparisons evaluated; fail-fast gives intervals_run==1; MetricCheck and Comparison exported
must_include: comparison in lt/le/gt/ge
failing on the first interval gives intervals_run == 1
MetricCheck and Comparison are importable from the top level

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_explicit_rollback_and_history: history records transitions; current() is latest; rollback_steps(steps=1) reverts
must_include: hist.entries() is a method returning the entries, each with entry.image
hist.current() is a
rollback_steps(steps=1)

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_scaling: scale() changes count without changing image; plan_scale to current count is a no-op
must_include: adjust the replica count to count WITHOUT changing the version
already being at the target count is a no-op
retires the largest-index replicas first

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_spec_loader: RolloutSpec parses/validates; canary_slots>replicas and canary-on-non-canary raise RevisionError
must_include: canary_slots must not exceed replicas
only the canary strategy may carry a canary evaluation block
self-contradictory manifests raise RevisionError
